candidates.authorityName: USDA Forest Service — Plumas National Forest
candidates.citation: lakesbasin.com — Lakes of the Lakes Basin; California Through My Lens — Lakes Basin Loop Hike

parameters.description: Cub Lake is a small lake accessible only by trail — about three-quarters of a mile from the trailhead along the Bear Lakes Loop in the Lakes Basin Recreation Area, Plumas National Forest, at roughly 6,600 feet elevation. It is described as the smallest of the lakes on the Lakes Basin Loop hike. No public CDFW stocking record was found for Cub Lake specifically.

candidates.summary: Small lake reached by a short trail (~0.75 mi) from the trailhead on the Bear Lakes Loop; part of the Lakes Basin Recreation Area and described as the smallest lake on the Lakes Basin Loop hike
